propositions: A new repeat-fix predicate detects when a non-test file touched by a bugfix has been modified by 2+ other bug-fix commits within 7 days on the base branch, escalating fixes under the 150-line size floor that would otherwise be exempt.

The repeat-fix signal catches 12 of 22 labelled bugs (50% recall) at 35.2% escalation rate, improving the size floor's 10/22 (41.7% recall) and 16.3% escalation when unioned to 14/22 (58.3%) at 39.2%.

The predicate ships in a new module with two parameters (REPEAT_FIX_WINDOW_DAYS=7, REPEAT_FIX_MIN_PRIOR=2) and is called by apply_bugfix_size_gate before attestation classification, preserving all existing exemptions.

The `flagged` field continues to mean the size floor alone; repeat-fix verdicts are reported in a new `escalation_reason` field and `repeat_fix_priors` list in coverage, leaving existing consumers unchanged.

Under-floor repeat-fix escalations must read no store data until the predicate fires; test_under_threshold_diff_never_reads_the_store is rewritten to pin that under-floor diffs with no non-test files or no repeat-fix hit skip attestation classification.

The backtest script gains --repeat-fix and --labels-from-caused-by options to measure recall against bugs whose caused_by field records a culprit, reconciling the 150-line floor at 16.3% escalation as a pinned baseline.
